persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Make an 8-second vertical promo for our Lantern Night, with glowing lanterns after dark. Put the date and venue big on screen so people know when and where to come. No voiceover.
bank.Event title and exact wording: Lantern Night; 14 November 2026; Willow Park, Bristol
bank.Visual style: Warm glowing lanterns outdoors after dark; other details are your call.
bank.Audio and language: English text, no voiceover. Music or silence is your call.

messages.text: Could you make a promo for our Lantern Night? I’m excited about the event and a little worried that the promo won’t get across how lovely it feels in person. What I’m after is an 8-second video in a vertical format. It should show glowing lanterns after dark. Please put the date and venue big on screen so people know when and where to come. I don’t want any voiceover.
